d: Short, layered sky blue hair with straight bangs and a soft texture. Narrow, closed-eye expression with a gentle smile. Apparent age of a young adult in their early twenties. Slender, athletic build. A royal blue long-coat with white trim and a high collar, worn over white trousers and white boots with black soles. A cream-colored cloak fastened by a silver buckle at the neck, a white belt with a silver buckle, and a gold-hilted sword sheathed at the hip.
